# mg37-source-apis

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

An old MonoGame 3.7 project whose source uses APIs that do not exist on the 3.8.6.1 desktop targets: `Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Net`, `GamerServices`, `OpenTK`, `Windows.UI.Xaml` and `Color.TransparentBlack`. One file uses `Color.Transparent`, which is fine. It is never built.

## Positive for

MG028, MG029, MG030, MG031, MG032.
